concerns.location: tasks.md:T012 (and 'Execution order' note 'T012 is parallel with T009–T011')
concerns.text: T012 is tagged [P] and declared parallel with T009–T011, but it runs the full pipeline (`--mode=synthetic --n=10000`) which writes `data/results/results.json` — the same file T011 must populate from the working dataset. Running them concurrently (or T012 after T011) clobbers T011's deliverable, so the [P] tag is unsafe. Either direct T012's run to a separate output path, or sequence T012 explicitly after T011 and drop the parallel claim.
